stem.en: A country has 25 seats and uses First Past The Post. Party A wins 15 seats, Party B wins 7 and Party C wins 3. What percentage of the seats does Party A hold?

explanation.en: 15 out of 25 is 15 ÷ 25 = 0.6, which is 60 per cent. Party A can hold 60 per cent of the seats even if its share of the votes is much lower.

hints.en: Divide the seats won by the total number of seats.
15 ÷ 25 = 0.6. Now write it as a percentage.
